performance_claim.reason: No fullrun was authorized. Exact label maturity and disjoint OOS corrections change the measurement substrate, so the corrected champion must be rebaselined before any improvement claim.

critical_findings.prior_state: Short labels used a 126-calendar-day feature cutoff and 12/24/36-month labels shared that frame; latest scoring could fall back to all prior rows.
critical_findings.corrected_state: Every stock and benchmark horizon stores its actual ending trading date. Training requires the complete blended label and label_available_at strictly before the decision date. The unpurged fallback is removed.

critical_findings.prior_state: Placeholder and calculated benchmark forward columns could merge into _x/_y columns, leaving canonical excess-return labels empty.
critical_findings.corrected_state: Placeholders are removed before merge and canonical benchmark value/provenance columns are asserted.
OOS2 defaults to 2023-01-01 through 2024-06-30 and any overlap fails closed.

critical_findings.prior_state: Two workflows could copy an eligible candidate directly over active feature gates.
critical_findings.corrected_state: Automatic learning is proposal-only and cannot mutate the champion even when invoked without --dry-run.

critical_findings.prior_state: Different end dates, target filters and metric modes are presented as baseline performance.
critical_findings.required_state: One source manifest, target-book hash, cost contract, reserve contract, lifecycle contract, date window and commit SHA must identify every promoted metric.

critical_findings.prior_state: Primary replay centers on fixed bps costs without full half-spread, ADV participation, volatility impact and capacity scenarios.
critical_findings.required_state: Add immutable 0.1%, 0.5% and 1.0% ADV scenarios and compare paper slippage with assumed impact.

critical_findings.prior_state: No integrated DSR, PBO, White Reality Check or SPA promotion gate was found.
critical_findings.required_state: Ledger-aware multiple-testing statistics must fail closed before a challenger can request a fullrun.

rejected_current_challengers.note: Keep the report-only tape; do not promote or repeat the same reconstruction.
MDD relief did not compensate for CAGR loss; concentrated MDD also worsened slightly.

ordered_next_work.prerequisite: Corrected champion identity and experiment ledger are trusted.
